chat.title: Agent session
chat.waitingForSandbox: waiting for the run to start ({{phase}})…
chat.waitingForSandboxReason: waiting for the run to start ({{phase}}): {{detail}}
chat.waitingForAcp: agent is starting — waiting for its ACP endpoint ({{detail}})…
chat.startingAcp: waiting for the agent to accept connections…
chat.disconnectedBody: The connection dropped repeatedly. The agent may be restarting — reconnect when it settles.
chat.connectionFailedHint: The agent pod may still be starting or crash-looping. Check the run's sandbox pod, then retry.
chat.connectedHint: Connected — waiting for the agent's first update.
chat.askClosedElsewhere: closed — timed out or answered elsewhere
chat.askDeclined: declined — the agent was told no answer was given
chat.askHint: The agent is waiting on this and cannot continue until someone answers (or the question times out).
chat.expand: Expand the transcript to full screen
chat.steerPlaceholder: Redirect the agent — it reads this at its next step…
chat.steerWaiting: Waiting for the agent to start — you can't redirect it yet…
chat.steerConnecting: Connecting to the agent — you can't redirect it yet…
chat.steerUnavailable: The agent isn't available to redirect.
chat.steerTurnOver: The agent's turn is over — nothing to redirect.
chat.steerAnswerFirst: Answer the question above before redirecting the agent…
chat.steerFootnote: Messages steer the agent's current turn
chat.steerFootnoteBody: Your message is queued into the turn the agent is working on and read at its next step — it redirects the work in progress instead of starting a new conversation. The run keeps going.
chat.steerQueued: queued — the agent reads it at its next step
chat.steerDropped: not picked up — the turn ended first
chat.steerDisabledByPolicy: Steering is switched off for this run by harness policy (HARNESS_HITL_STEER=off).
chat.steerNoActiveRun: The agent is not in a turn right now, so there is nothing to redirect.
chat.cancelTurnBody: This cancels the turn the agent is working on. The run is marked failed; whatever the agent already pushed stays on the target branch.
chat.cancelRequested: stop requested — the agent halts at its next step
chat.closedElsewhere: closed — timed out or answered elsewhere
chat.noSessionAccessTitle: Your role cannot open the live session
chat.noSessionAccessBody: Watching or steering an agent session needs the agentic.agentruns.acp scope, which the hub grants to the admin, architect and migrator roles. The run status above still updates.
chat.usageContextUnreported: Context window: {{limit}} tokens. This provider does not report how much is in use.
chat.usageTurns: Turn {{turn}}, as counted by the harness
chat.usageTurnsOf: Turn {{turn}} of a {{max}}-turn budget, as counted by the harness
chat.waitingForAcpCondition: The run is {{phase}} but the controller reports no ACPReady condition; the console dials only on that signal (agentic-controller#160).
chat.endingSession: the agent session ended — checking the run's status…
chat.sessionEndedDivider: the agent session ended — waiting for the final status…
chat.sessionEndedBody: The run's agent has stopped. Waiting for the controller to report its final status…
chat.finishedTranscriptHint: The live transcript is only available while the run is active.
chat.finishedPushHint: Any commits the agent made are on the target branch — a run that produced no commits pushes nothing, so the branch may not exist.
chat.failureReasonUnknown: The controller recorded no reason. Check the run's sandbox pod logs for details.
chat.runFailedNoPushTitle: The agent could not push to the repository
chat.runFailedNoPushBody: The run's final push was rejected: the application's repository has no source credential with write access attached, so the agent could read the code but could not push its branch. Nothing reached the target branch. Attach a credential with write access, then run the agent again.

createRun.title: Create run
createRun.noAgentsBody: The cluster has no Agent CRs in the shim's namespace, so there is nothing to run.
createRun.inventoryRequiredBody: this agent resolves its inputs from an application, so a run cannot be created until the inventory loads.
createRun.gatewayHelper: One gateway is one model. The controller uses the agent's only gateway when you leave this on Default.
createRun.gatewayRequiredHelper: This agent declares several gateways, so the run must name one — the controller will not choose for you.
createRun.gatewayUnconstrainedHelper: No gateway is declared, so any Ready gateway in the cluster may be used — the run must name one; the controller will not choose for you.
createRun.gatewayNoneAvailable: No gateways exist in the cluster. A run needs one, and gateways are managed cluster-side.
createRun.executionModeApprove: Approval required — ask before tool calls
createRun.executionModeHelper: Choose whether tool calls proceed automatically or wait for your approval.
createRun.executionModeApproveWarningTitle: Keep the run details page open to approve tool calls
createRun.executionModeApproveWarningBody: After creating the run, stay on its details page while it is running. If no viewer is connected to answer an approval request, the request is denied and the agent cannot continue that action.
createRun.askUser: Let the agent ask you questions
createRun.askUserHelper: Gives the agent a tool to pause mid-turn and ask a question in the run's session panel. Off by default.
createRun.askUserWarningTitle: Keep the run details page open to answer the agent's questions
createRun.askUserWarningBody: The agent will not guess an answer on your behalf. If nobody answers a question before it times out, the run fails. Turn this on only for a run you will be watching.
createRun.createdRunMissingName: Shim returned a created run without metadata.name
createRun.instructionsPlaceholder: Task-specific instructions, composed with the agent's standing prompt
createRun.agentNotReadyTitle: Agent {{name}} is not ready — a run created now would wait until it is
createRun.noSkills: No skills — the agent runs on its prompt alone.
createRun.prefillAgentMissing: The earlier run's agent "{{name}}" no longer exists — pick another agent.
createRun.credentialResolvedApplication: This run will push as {{name}} — the source credential attached to this application.
createRun.credentialResolvedDefault: This run will push as {{name}} — the default source credential. Nothing is attached to this application, so the default is what the harness falls back to.
createRun.credentialMissingTitle: {{name}} has no source credential — this run will not be able to push
createRun.credentialMissingBody: No source credential is attached to this application, and no credential is marked as the source default. The agent can read the repository and do its work, but the final push is denied and the run fails at the very end. Create a source credential in <admin>Administration › Credentials</admin>, then attach it to this application with its <apps>Manage credentials</apps> action.
createRun.credentialUnattachedTitle_one: Credential {{names}} exists but is not attached to {{name}}
createRun.credentialUnattachedTitle_other: Source credentials exist ({{names}}) but none is attached to {{name}}
createRun.credentialUnattachedBody_one: The harness uses the credential attached to the application, or failing that the one marked as the source default — this credential is neither, so the agent can read the repository but will not be able to push its branch. Attach it with the application's <apps>Manage credentials</apps> action, or mark it as the default in <admin>Administration › Credentials</admin>.
createRun.credentialUnattachedBody_other: The harness uses the credential attached to the application, or failing that the one marked as the source default — none of these is either, so the agent can read the repository but will not be able to push its branch. Attach one with the application's <apps>Manage credentials</apps> action, or mark one as the default in <admin>Administration › Credentials</admin>.

agents.nameHelper: DNS-1123 subdomain: lowercase alphanumeric, hyphens, dots
agents.skillSummary: {{rules}} rules always loaded · {{skills}} on-demand skills · {{collections}} collections
agents.skillsGuidance: Skills are optional. Rules are injected into every prompt; skills are loaded when the agent decides they are relevant. A stage that depends on a skill should name it in its instructions.
agents.noParams: No parameters declared. A run supplies values for the parameters an agent declares here.

agentic.emptyStateSeedHint: Default agents, skills, and workflows are seeded on the cluster by an administrator.

workflows.nameHelper: Lowercase alphanumeric, dots, and hyphens (e.g. my-migration-workflow)
workflows.guidePlaceholder: High-level guidance shared with every stage (optional)
workflows.artifactChainingBody: Each stage commits its output to TARGET_BRANCH. The next stage's skill reads from the same branch.
workflows.gatewayOverlapWarning: Stages reference different gateways ({{gateways}}). A workflow run uses one gateway for every stage, so pick agents that share one.
workflows.stageNamePattern: Lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens only (must start with a letter)

workflowRuns.emptyBody: Workflow runs execute the stages of a workflow in order, each as its own agent run. Create a workflow run to get started.
workflowRuns.notFoundBody: The workflow run {{name}} was not found. It may have been deleted.
workflowRuns.noStageStatusBody: The controller has not populated stage status — the workflow may not be Ready.
workflowRuns.approvalViewerTitle: Keep this page open for workflow approvals
workflowRuns.approvalViewerBody: This page automatically connects to the active {{stage}} stage. If it asks for approval and no viewer is connected, the tool call is denied.
workflowRuns.liveStageLoadFailed: Unable to load the active workflow stage
workflowRuns.createDescription: Creates an AgentWorkflowRun; the controller executes each stage as its own AgentRun, in order, on a shared target branch.
workflowRuns.createdWithoutName: Shim returned a created run without metadata.name
workflowRuns.noWorkflowsBody: The cluster has no AgentWorkflow CRs in the shim's namespace, so there is nothing to run.
workflowRuns.failedLoadStageAgentsTitle: Failed to load the workflow's stage agents
workflowRuns.failedLoadStageAgentsBody: {{error}} — the run form is built from the stage Agents' declared params, so a run cannot be created until they load.
workflowRuns.failedLoadApplicationsBody: {{error}} — workflow runs that work on a Hub application cannot be created until the inventory loads.
workflowRuns.applicationHelper: Every stage's harness pulls this application's repository, credentials, and analysis from the Hub. Migration workflows fail without one.
workflowRuns.noRepositoryBody: {{name}} has no repository URL in the Hub — the harness clones from the Hub record, so these stages cannot start. Set the application's source repository first.
workflowRuns.targetBranchInvalid: Must be a valid git branch name and differ from the application's source branch.
workflowRuns.targetBranchHelper: One branch, all stages: each stage continues the previous stage's work on it (plan commits PLAN.md, execute reads it).
workflowRuns.paramNotDeclared_one: not declared by stage {{stages}} — cannot be set on a workflow run (params forward to every stage)
workflowRuns.paramNotDeclared_other: not declared by stages {{stages}} — cannot be set on a workflow run (params forward to every stage)
workflowRuns.prefillWorkflowMissing: The earlier run's workflow "{{name}}" no longer exists — pick another workflow.

validation.noFrontmatter: Content must start with a YAML frontmatter block (a line containing only ---).
validation.unterminatedFrontmatter: Frontmatter is not closed: add a line containing only --- after the YAML header.
validation.noDescription: Frontmatter needs a description — it is the only thing the agent uses to decide whether to load this skill.
validation.descriptionTooLong: Description is {{count}} characters; the limit is 1024.
validation.nameInvalid: Name "{{name}}" must be lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, and cannot start or end with a hyphen.
validation.nameTooLong: Name is {{count}} characters; the limit is 64.
validation.unexpectedFields: Frontmatter has fields the Agent Skills spec does not define: {{fields}}. Only name, description, license, compatibility, metadata and allowed-tools are allowed; put anything else under metadata.
validation.emptyBody: The skill has no content after the frontmatter.
validation.nameDiffersFromCard: The agent will see this skill as "{{name}}" (its frontmatter name), not as the skill card name.
validation.invalidYaml: The value of {{fields}} contains ": " or ends with a colon, which YAML reads as a nested mapping. Wrap the value in double quotes.

gateways.description: LLM endpoints the agents run against: one provider and model per gateway. Gateways are managed cluster-side; this view is read-only.
gateways.emptyBody: No Gateway resources found. Agents need at least one to run.
gateways.unverifiableProviderTooltip: The controller verifies a gateway by probing GET /v1/models, which the native {{provider}} API does not serve — verification reports {{reason}} and cannot pass (agentic-controller#167). Agents referencing this gateway stay Not Ready.
gateways.unverifiableAlertTitle_other: {{count}} gateways cannot pass the controller's verification: {{names}}
gateways.unverifiableAlertBody: The controller verifies a gateway by probing GET /v1/models on its endpoint, which the native aws-bedrock and gcp-vertex-ai APIs do not serve, so these gateways never become Ready and every Agent that references them stays Not Ready — runs are blocked behind that hold even with valid credentials. Tracked as <issue>agentic-controller#167</issue>.

fetchError.title: Unable to load agentic resources
fetchError.rbacTitle: The Hub cannot read agentic resources
fetchError.rbacHint: The Hub's ServiceAccount was denied by Kubernetes RBAC. The Hub reads Agents, Gateways, AgentRuns and their credential Secrets from its own namespace only, so they must be created there, and the tackle-hub ServiceAccount needs a Role granting access to konveyor.io resources in that namespace.
